questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code tracks which authors currently have live viewers? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
What happens to a published post when the fanout queue already holds 10,000 undelivered posts?
choices: Publish blocks the calling request until the consumer catches up
The oldest queued post is dropped to make room and Publish still returns true
The new post is rejected and Publish returns false

questions.prompt: A connection that subscribed to three authors loses its network connection. What does OnDisconnectedAsync do and what does SignalR do for the groups?
choices: It must also call RemoveFromGroupAsync for each author, otherwise the connection stays in the groups forever
It decrements the viewer count for each subscribed author; SignalR removes the connection from its groups itself
It does nothing, because the viewer counts are recomputed on every fanout
It decrements the counts and sends a goodbye message to the groups

questions.prompt: One post's SendAsync throws an unexpected non-cancellation exception. What is the effect on later posts?
choices: The BackgroundService stops and no further posts are delivered until restart
The exception is logged and the loop moves on to the next post
The same post is retried until it succeeds
